title: Carl Rinker introduces himself as a Chicago trumpeter
summary: Rinker states he played trumpet in Chicago from about 1924 to 1939, when he left for other work.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: My name is Carl Rinker and I play trumpet. I played in Chicago from starting about 1924 until roughly about 1939 when I discontinued trumpet playing to go into other work.
